paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Zohar, Toldot 139a, in Midrash HaNe’elam, where he reported in Rabbi Beruka’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Vocalized Zohar, Israel 2013 text of Toldot 8:66 has Rav Kahana reporting Rabbi Beruka. These explicit local titles support the English here. The newer chapter-and-paragraph address was found through the work’s actual structure and a named-book search, then checked in the whole passage; Hyman’s Toldot 139a locator is retained. The paragraph contains a Vilna-page overlay marker for 139b, which is digital metadata, not a fresh printed-page collation or an identity with a Bavli Kahana. The earlier invalid complex-book lookup remains preserved.
